voteA.causalExplanation: The handler aggregates every item period with Math.max, which matches the Basil per-item contract. The observed renewalDate equals that maximum, so the write is an adaptation rather than a silent break.

voteB.causalExplanation: The handler reads only items.data[0].current_period_end and writes that timestamp. That value does not preserve the previously evidenced subscription-level renewal and does not implement documented aggregation.
